# Related repositories

this: rockcarver/frodo-lib

related:
  - role: cli
    repo: rockcarver/frodo-cli
    when: |
      Issues that are strictly about the CLI wrapper: argument parsing,
      help text, output formatting, packaging, or distribution.
      Core library behavior belongs here.

notes: |
  This is the library. Most functional issues belong here.
  Suggest the CLI repository only for pure CLI-surface problems.
